preconditions.description: The length of the sequence is between 1 and 10^5.
The elements of sequences a and b are in the range from l to r.
The elements of sequence a are in the range from l to r.
The compressed sequence of sequence c contains all integers from 1 to n inclusively.
All elements of sequence a are distinct.
All elements of the compressed sequence of sequence c are distinct.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (len(output) == n and all(l <= output_i <= r for output_i in output))
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a sequence b of length n where all elements are in the range from l to r.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 if not exists b such that for all i: p_i == (b_i - a_i).count(x for x in c if x <= b_i - a_i)
postconditions.description: The output is -1 if there is no sequence b that satisfies the condition for the given sequence a and compressed sequence p.

postconditions.expression: exists b such that for all i: p_i == (b_i - a_i).count(x for x in c if x <= b_i - a_i) and all(b_i != b_j for i != j)
postconditions.description: The output is a sequence b that satisfies the condition for the given sequence a and compressed sequence p, and all elements of b are distinct.
